instruction: Candid full shot of a couple on a white mattress in a pine forest. On the left, the woman in the light blue short-sleeved shirt and shorts (R1) stands balancing, looking down. On the right, the man in the white t-shirt and light blue pants (R2) bends forward deeply, head down. They hold hands as he loses his balance. Soft, diffused daylight illuminates the natural forest setting and the white bedding.
